meta.title: GTA VI Trophy Guide — Projected 55-Trophy Roadmap
meta.status: PROJECTED — as of 20 November 2026 Rockstar/Take-Two have not published an official GTA VI trophy list via PSN. All 55 entries are projections modelled on the structure of the Grand Theft Auto V PS5 base-game list. Names, ranks and requirements will be replaced when the official list appears.
meta.modelledOn: Grand Theft Auto V PS5 base-game list (51 trophies: 1 platinum, 3 gold, 5 silver, 42 bronze), extended to 55 entries: 1 platinum, 3 gold, 8 silver, 43 bronze.

roadmap.title: First story playthrough (45-60h)
roadmap.text: Play the campaign once, swapping leads between Jason and Lucia whenever the game allows so character-count trophies tick up in parallel. Keep a manual save before any mission with a choice, a heist approach pick, or a unique vehicle reward. Ignore collectible grinding for now — the map is still unlocking, which makes the sweep slower, not faster.

roadmap.title: Post-credits cleanup (35-55h)
roadmap.text: With Leonida fully open, work the 100% checklist category by category: regional discovery first (it unlocks fast-travel convenience), then collectible sets, then races and stunts, then hobbies. Use this app's filters to track what is left; the category buttons mirror the in-game checklist.

roadmap.title: Grind the stragglers (20-40h)
roadmap.text: Whatever remains: gold-medal replays of story missions, the wanted-level and first-person accumulation trophies, wealth targets, and any stat maxing. Nothing here is technically hard — it is pure time. Verify the trophy list against this app's progress tracker before claiming the platinum.

missables.title: Finale outcome choice
missables.text: The final mission is expected to present an outcome choice in the GTA V tradition. Take the option that keeps both protagonists alive (GTA V's Ending C pattern); there is no way back without a fresh save. Check this section before starting the last mission, not during it.

missables.title: Heist approach locks
missables.text: If a score locks in one approach after the planning board, the opposite-approach trophy for that job becomes unrepeatable in that playthrough. Keep a save from before every planning board so both stealth and loud routes stay reachable.

missables.title: Story-unique vehicles
missables.text: Vehicles rewarded during the story should be stored in a purchased garage immediately and never sold. GTA V permanently deleted sold story-unlocked cars; assume the same behaviour until proven otherwise.

missables.title: Protagonist-locked side content
missables.text: In GTA V, side threads tied to one character (rampages, bail bonds) could not be finished after that character's arc closed. If a stranger thread or activity appears only for Jason or only for Lucia, play it when it appears rather than saving it for later.

missables.title: One-shot random events
missables.text: Events that spawn once (robberies you witness, rescues) may not respawn after being ignored or failed. Stop for every event marker you see during the story; the time cost is minutes, the replay cost is a second playthrough.

trophies.name: Sunshine Empire
trophies.description: Unlock every other trophy in Grand Theft Auto VI.
trophies.howTo: The platinum pops the moment the final individual trophy unlocks. Manage the missables flagged below from the first hour and the platinum is a straightforward — if very long — time investment.

trophies.name: Blood and Sand
trophies.missableNote: Finish or replay every story mission before the credits roll; a skipped mission may be unreachable from the menu afterwards.
trophies.description: Complete every main story mission.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Work through the campaign markers without skipping any; if a mission is ever abandoned, reopen it from the pause menu before moving on. Cross-check against the in-game story progress percentage.

trophies.name: Sunburnt Checklist
trophies.description: Attain 100% game completion.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA V's 'Career Criminal'. The aggregate of missions, side threads, hobbies, collectibles and miscellaneous checklist items. Longest single trophy in the game; see the roadmap phases.

trophies.name: Beachfront Finances
trophies.description: Accumulate a seven-figure fortune across cash and assets.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Heist payouts plus property income carry most players over the line during cleanup. If a GTA V-style stock-market beat exists around story events, invest heavily before those missions and sell at the peak.

trophies.name: Out of the Sun
trophies.missableNote: Choice-dependent finale; read the missables section before starting the last mission.
trophies.description: Complete the final story mission.
trophies.howTo: Projected finale trophy. Automatic with the story — provided you have kept insurance saves for the outcome choice flagged as missable.

trophies.name: The Leonida Grand Tour
trophies.description: Discover every named district across all six regions.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on 'San Andreas Sightseer'. Six confirmed regions: Vice City, Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia, Mount Kalaga National Park (Rockstar's region tour). Drive each region's spine roads, then mop up district markers on the map.

trophies.name: Sovereigns of the Swamp
trophies.description: Collect all items in one large scattered collectible set.
trophies.howTo: Projected, the GTA V spaceship-parts slot. Expect a 50-ish object set with map markers unlocking after a story milestone. Sweep by region with a helicopter once the markers appear.

trophies.name: Gilded Replays
trophies.description: Earn gold medals on a large share of story missions.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA V's 'Solid Gold, Baby!'. Replay missions from the pause menu and chase the per-mission objectives (time, accuracy, special goals). A relaxed second pass after the story earns most medals.

trophies.name: Dilettante No More
trophies.missableNote: If any hobby is locked to one protagonist, play it during that character's story window; character-locked content may close after their arc.
trophies.description: Win a gold rating in every hobby and pastime.
trophies.howTo: Projected, keeping GTA V's 'Multi-Disciplined' archetype. Confirmed hobby hooks: hunting, fishing and off-road trails in Mount Kalaga; expect tennis, golf or beach sports in Vice City. One gold rating in each activity.

trophies.name: Chairman of the Score
trophies.description: Complete every major heist in the story.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Automatic on a complete story playthrough; the heist-planning missable note about approach saves is the only real risk.

trophies.name: Table Games Titan
trophies.description: Win every table game or minigame at least once.
trophies.howTo: Projected, the GTA V casino/boardwalk slot. If Leonida's venues include card or dice minigames, sit down at each one and take a single win; house edges do not matter for the trophy, only one W on the board.

trophies.name: Peak Physique
trophies.description: Max out a protagonist's core stats.
trophies.howTo: Projected. GTA V maxed stats through practice: stamina by cycling, strength by sport, lung capacity by diving, flying by hours in the air. Grind each skill's boosting activity during cleanup; passive gains from normal play cover about half of it.

trophies.name: Welcome to Paradise
trophies.description: Complete the opening chapter.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Unlocks automatically within the first hour as Jason and Lucia's easy score goes wrong — the premise Rockstar leads with.

trophies.name: Life in the Slow Lane
trophies.description: Complete the Leonida Keys story chapter.
trophies.howTo: Projected chapter trophy for the confirmed island-chain region where Jason lives and works for local drug runners.

trophies.name: Neon Return
trophies.description: Complete the first Vice City story chapter.
trophies.howTo: Projected chapter trophy. Vice City is the confirmed heart of Leonida; follow the story markers downtown.

trophies.name: Mangrove Justice
trophies.description: Complete the Grassrivers story chapter.
trophies.howTo: Projected chapter trophy for the Everglades-inspired wetlands.

trophies.name: Rust and Salt
trophies.description: Complete the Port Gellhorn story chapter.
trophies.howTo: Projected chapter trophy for the confirmed Gulf Coast region of shuttered motels and empty strip malls.

trophies.name: Bitter Harvest
trophies.description: Complete the Ambrosia story chapter.
trophies.howTo: Projected chapter trophy for the confirmed inland industrial town.

trophies.name: Above the Treeline
trophies.description: Complete the Mount Kalaga story chapter.
trophies.howTo: Projected chapter trophy for the confirmed national park on Leonida's northern border.

trophies.name: Right Behind You
trophies.description: Complete a mission sequence with both Jason and Lucia working together.
trophies.howTo: Projected, named for Jason's confirmed line 'If anything happens, I'm right behind you.' A partnership milestone trophy is near-certain given the duo structure.

trophies.name: Two Sides of the Coin
trophies.description: Switch between Jason and Lucia 25 times.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA V's trio-switching trophies. Instant when the pair are together, a few seconds when apart (Extended Look demo). Alternate constantly and this unlocks mid-campaign.

trophies.name: Smart Moves Only
trophies.description: Complete 15 story missions played primarily as Lucia.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Lucia's confirmed bio: 'Lucia's learned her lesson — only smart moves from here.' Track your lead per mission and balance the count against Jason's.

trophies.name: Easy Life, Hard Times
trophies.description: Complete 15 story missions played primarily as Jason.
trophies.howTo: Projected, named for Jason's bio line 'Jason wants an easy life, but things just keep getting harder.' Mirror of the Lucia mission-count trophy.

trophies.name: Cold Case, Closed
trophies.description: Solve a multi-part mystery collectible.
trophies.howTo: Projected, the GTA V Leonora Johnson letter slot. Clues gather across one region and end in a discovery scene; collect every clue before visiting the finale location.

trophies.name: Reef Raids
trophies.description: Recover a full set of underwater collectibles.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA V's nuclear-waste barrels. Reef lines east of the Keys are the likely biome; buy the boat-access property first if Rockstar repeats the GTA V dock requirement.

trophies.name: Sunfish Stash
trophies.description: Find all hidden packages across the state.
trophies.howTo: Projected classic hidden-package hunt, projected count 50-100. Grab them in bulk during cleanup free roam with an aircraft.

trophies.name: Field Guide Author
trophies.description: Catalogue every species in the wildlife logbook.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on RDR2's animal-study pattern. Dawn hours spawn the widest variety; the Grassrivers and Mount Kalaga cover most species between them.

trophies.name: Dial Every Dial
trophies.description: Listen to every radio station at least once.
trophies.howTo: Projected, easy. Rockstar promises 'the biggest and widest-ranging selection of in-game radio yet' plus on-demand podcasts. Cycle stations across any long drive.

trophies.name: Episode Completionist
trophies.description: Listen to every on-demand podcast episode.
trophies.howTo: Projected. GTA VI introduces on-demand podcasts for Jason and Lucia via headphones (Rockstar, Nov 2026). Play every episode once through the phone UI.

trophies.name: First Big Score
trophies.description: Complete your first major heist.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Automatic on the story path — the GTA V heist trophy pattern is expected to repeat with bigger jobs across Leonida.

trophies.name: Full Crew, Full Cut
trophies.description: Complete a heist with a full specialist crew.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Hire a complete crew at the planning board; expect the GTA V skill-versus-cut trade-off, so take the cheap option once just for the trophy.

trophies.name: Nobody Saw Nothing
trophies.missableNote: Approach choice at the planning board may lock the other route for that score; keep a pre-planning save.
trophies.description: Complete any major heist via a stealth approach without raising an alarm.
trophies.howTo: Projected ghost-run trophy. Save before the board, pick the quiet approach, invest in better gear upfront, and go slow — checkpoints make retries cheap.

trophies.name: Kick the Door In
trophies.missableNote: Same approach-lock risk as the stealth trophy; both need that pre-planning save.
trophies.description: Complete any major heist via the aggressive approach.
trophies.howTo: Projected loud-run trophy. Heavy armour, an assault loadout, and controlled pushes between cover points beat the aggressive route's swarms.

trophies.name: Losses Recouped
trophies.description: Complete a heist finale escape while evading a high wanted level.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Plan the getaway vehicle swap in advance and use the alley routes your crew marks; break line of sight before the heat spikes.

trophies.name: Reserved Parking
trophies.description: Own ten or more vehicles across your garages.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA Online's garage trophies. Buy cheap and steal the rest; store story-unique cars immediately (see missables).

trophies.name: Ramp Champ
trophies.description: Complete all stunt jumps.
trophies.howTo: Projected, keeping GTA V's 'Show Off' archetype. Land in each target zone; retry the finicky ones from the nearest save. Approach speed matters more than vehicle choice.

trophies.name: Gulf Coast Aviator
trophies.description: Fly every type of aircraft.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Helicopter and fixed-wing are certain; a seaplane is likely given the Keys. Take one flight in each type from any airfield.

trophies.name: Saltwater Sovereign
trophies.description: Pilot every type of watercraft.
trophies.howTo: Projected. The Keys guarantee boats and jet skis; cruise-ship docks imply larger craft. One spin in each counts.

trophies.name: Ocean Drive Circuit
trophies.description: Win a street race in Vice City.
trophies.howTo: Projected. A fast mid-range sports car and clean racing lines beat the AI comfortably; races unlock on the map during cleanup.

trophies.name: Land, Sea and Sky
trophies.description: Win a race in every discipline.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA V's street/sea/air triplet. Win one of each — street, boat, aircraft. Upgrades make the aircraft event the only tricky one.

trophies.name: Line in the Water
trophies.description: Catch one of every fish species.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Fishing is confirmed via Mount Kalaga and the Keys region tours. Different species by water type and time of day; the rarest needs a boat offshore.

trophies.name: Kalaga Huntsman
trophies.description: Complete a hunting excursion.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Mount Kalaga offers confirmed 'prime hunting' (Rockstar region tour). Follow the tracking markers and take the clean shot when prompted.

trophies.name: Iron Sunbather
trophies.description: Complete a multi-discipline endurance event.
trophies.howTo: Projected, keeping GTA V's triathlon archetype. Vice City's beach culture makes a swim/bike/run event near-certain. No skill required, just pacing.

trophies.name: After Dark
trophies.description: Experience every type of Vice City nightlife venue.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Boobie Ike's club and recording studio are confirmed; visit each venue type and complete one activity inside each.

trophies.name: Landlord of Leonida
trophies.description: Own one of every purchasable property type.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA V's property trophies. Buy one of each business type as money allows and complete its associated activity once.

trophies.name: Three Stars at Sundown
trophies.description: Survive three minutes on a three-star wanted level or higher, off-mission.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA V's 'Three Man Army'. Use a garage or alley to break line of sight and watch the clock; switching characters can keep the timer interesting.

trophies.name: Ghost of the Glades
trophies.description: Lose a five-star wanted level without dying or using a respray.
trophies.howTo: Projected. The Grassrivers swamps hide your wanted ellipse fastest — a boat into the mangroves is the classic escape.

trophies.name: Through Jason's Eyes
trophies.description: Accumulate 15 hours of play in first-person mode.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA V PS5's 'A New Perspective'. Set first person as the default camera early and forget about it — the hours accumulate during normal play.

trophies.name: Out of Your Depth
trophies.description: Encounter a large predator while diving.
trophies.howTo: Projected, keeping GTA V's exact trophy name as the archetype. Swim deep off the Keys coast until something large appears; no damage required, just the encounter.

trophies.name: Delivered Breathing
trophies.missableNote: Bounty-style side jobs were missable mid-story in GTA V; play this strand when it first opens.
trophies.description: Capture a bounty target alive.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on 'Wanted: Alive or Alive'. Use the non-lethal takedown on the target and deliver them breathing — the melee or taser route, not gunfire.

trophies.name: Enlightenment, Maybe
trophies.missableNote: Cult strands in GTA V required specific donations and choices; complete each step as it opens.
trophies.description: Complete a cult or conspiracy-theory side storyline.
trophies.howTo: Projected, the 'Kifflom!' slot. A cult-style thread is a GTA tradition; follow all its steps and make the required choices. Cal Hampton's confirmed paranoia makes this a plausible Leonida thread.

trophies.name: Good Samaritan
trophies.description: Complete a set of random events.
trophies.howTo: Projected, modelled on GTA V's random-event trophies. Stop for every event marker during the story (see the one-shot-events missable) and the set completes itself.

trophies.name: Wardrobe Malfunction
trophies.description: Change each protagonist's full outfit at least once.
trophies.howTo: Projected, easy. Any clothing store swap counts; Vice City's shops carry the widest catalogue.

trophies.name: Mass Transit Commuter
trophies.description: Ride every public transit or tour service.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Buses, any metro line and boat tours each count; wait at the marked stops and ride each route once.

trophies.name: Beach Brawl
trophies.description: Win ten fistfights without firing a shot.
trophies.howTo: Projected. Bait swings, block, then counter; bars and the boardwalk respawn willing opponents all night.
